**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Jarred
solution: The correct answer is: '**Altercated'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**jarred**" means causing a feeling of unease or discord.(बेचैनी या कलह की भावना पैदा करना) • Similarly, "**altercated**" means to engage in a heated or argumentative dispute or quarrel.(तर्कपूर्ण विवाद या झगड़े में शामिल होना) • Example: "The heated debate between the two politicians **jarred **the atmosphere in the room." • In this example, "jarred" describes the tense and uncomfortable impact of the argument. • Example: The two neighbors **altercated **loudly in the middle of the street, drawing the attention of passersby. • In summary, the correct answer is "**altercated**" as it conveys the sense of engaging in a heated dispute or quarrel, which aligns with the meaning of "**jarred**" in the context of conflict or discord. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Other options: • **Assented**: This option means to agree or give approval.(सहमत होना या अनुमोदन देना) • Example: "He assented to the proposal without any objections." • This usage does not align with the meaning of "jarred." • **Accorded**: This option means to grant or give someone something.(किसी को कुछ देना या देना) • Example: "The committee accorded him the honor of presenting the award." • This usage does not align with the meaning of "jarred." • **Macho**: This option refers to a characteristic of exaggerated masculinity or toughness.(अतिरंजित पुरुषत्व या कठोरता का एक लक्षण) • Example: "He displayed a macho attitude by taking unnecessary risks." • This usage does not align with the meaning of "jarred." 41:T6db, The correct answer is** 3) biased**.
